name: Legal Data Hunter
description: Legal Data Hunter is trying to build the world's first omni-jurisdictional legal database, giving Claude access to 23M+ documents from 160+ jurisdictions in one MCP server. We ingest directly from official registries : Légifrance, EUR-Lex, BOE, RIS, the Bundesgerichtshof, the European Court of Human Rights, and 180+ more, covering EU consolidated law, supreme and constitutional court case law, and official doctrine. Resolve loose citations (ECLI, CELEX, case numbers), search with hybrid semantic + keyword filters, and fetch full document text. Authoritative primary sources only, no scraped web copy.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Legal Data Hunter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Legal Data Hunter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://legaldatahunter.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Legal Data Hunter MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Legal Data Hunter provides these MCP tools: search, resolve_reference, get_document, discover_countries, discover_sources, get_filters, and report_source_issue.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Legal Data Hunter?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Legal Data Hunter in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Legal Data Hunter MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Legal Data Hunter requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Legal Data Hunter is developed by GoodLegal. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
